rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for one's mother.

example.english: Mom, are you coming to pick me up after school today?
example.traditional: 媽媽，今日放學你嚟唔嚟接我呀？
example.jyutping: maa1 maa1 gam1 jat6 fong3 hok6 nei5 lai4 m4 lai4 zip3 ngo5 aa3

rows.note: Use this family nickname for a mother, or when a father addresses his wife as the children's mom.

example.english: Mom, Dad says it’s time to eat!
example.jyutping: maa1 mi4 baa4 baa1 giu3 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa3
